summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests ALE.P03, a claudin-1 targeted antibody-drug conjugate, given alone to adults with selected advanced or metastatic CLDN1-positive solid tumors, including cervical squamous cell carcinoma, squamous non-small cell lung cancer, colorectal cancer, intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, and urothelial carcinoma. ALE.P03 is given as an intravenous infusion, and the dosing schedule and how often it is given are not stated. The study measures safety and tolerability, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, early anti-tumor activity, and aims to identify the recommended Phase II dose.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa ALE.P03, un conjugado anticuerpo-fármaco dirigido a claudina-1, administrado solo a adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados o metastásicos seleccionados y CLDN1 positivos, incluidos carcinoma de células escamosas cervical, carcinoma de pulmón de células no pequeñas de tipo escamoso, cáncer colorrectal, colangiocarcinoma intrahepático y carcinoma urotelial. ALE.P03 se administra como infusión intravenosa; el esquema de dosis y la frecuencia no se indican. El estudio mide seguridad y tolerabilidad, farmacocinética, farmacodinamia y actividad antitumoral preliminar, y busca identificar la dosis recomendada para la fase II.
who_for: Advanced or metastatic colorectal cancer, intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, squamous non-small cell lung cancer, urothelial carcinoma, or cervical squamous cell
Radiological disease progression at study entry.
Tissue provided for CLDN1 analysis at a central laboratory.
Refractory or intolerant to standard treatment, with measurable disease and ECOG performance status 0 or 1.
not_for: Squamous lung or cervical tumors with a predominantly non-squamous or adenocarcinoma histology.
Antineoplastic therapy received before study treatment within a specified time frame (time frame not stated).
Known active brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis.
Non-infectious interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis requiring steroids, or clinically significant gastrointestinal bleeding.
